title: Rules page redesign: seven one-screen illustrated pages
problem: The Rules page (How to play) is seven pages of text with small pictures; the tips sit on a page of their own, away from the decisions they are about.
scope: Owner's changes (2026-11-24): the first page is headed How to play (no Start or Quick start), "against rival stalls", "Each stall starts with" above the $10, and only "A game lasts 8, 10 or 14 days." under the shopkeeper

Owner (second round): the first page's shopkeeper section replaced by the day's turns (buy in turn; stock and price at once, in secret; the rush) as picture tiles of shopkeepers and a customer; page 2 is Customer (design C, reworded), with buttons that point a moving ring at fruit, quantity, top price and freshness on a face-up and a face-down card, and Buying/Stocking/Next morning buttons on the board; page 3, The lorry, with the lorry card, the deck back, an unloading lorry and tomorrow's lorry

Owner (third round): page 1's turns flow down a winding path with pictures (the market board for Buy, fruit into a crate for Stock, Rosa pricing in secret for Price, two customer characters cut from their cards for Rush); Customer: the pointing is done from linked words in the description, and the board ends with the Tomorrow strip; Lorry: renamed, reworded, the market first, the lorry card and the deck back, then the lorry arriving at the Wholesale Market

Owner (fourth round): pages in the owner's order (How to play, Fruit & freshness, Customer, Favour, Lorry, Event, Market Day, Try a sale), each fitting one phone screen; How to play back to the four picture tiles; Fruit & freshness as the market board, freshest at the top, then who buys what; Customer: one customer's card face up and face down, the favour sentence, same-size cards and a moving Next morning; Favour cards to swipe; Lorry: the card and the lorry arriving; a new Event page in the same shape; Market Day: the standing order and upgrades in plain words; One market day and the tips removed

Owner (fifth round): no Play a day; the game length centred; Fruit & freshness names the four fruits, fills the board from a real lorry card (Mixed Basket at 3 stalls), opens a card per fruit (what it is like, costs by freshness, what customers usually pay, how long it keeps), with a smaller Advance 1 night; who buys what moves behind an (i) on the Customer page; Lorry and Event become one page of the two decks to swipe, after Fruit & freshness
Quick start: an illustrated stall, the $10 starting cash and "Most cash wins.", with the shopkeeper choice beside a real shopkeeper card
One market day: one action line and one picture per step; a rival crate shown with only its piece count, then opened at the bell
Fruit & freshness: the track with Fresh on the right and Advance one night; who buys what in a three-row table; a mango's two nights from Green to Fresh
Try a sale: Bobby Books's card and three small stalls; pick who sells first, then the sale is revealed piece by piece; then Fresh only; price ties in a row that opens
Favours & closing: a whole order earning a face-down favour card; the favour cards grouped by when they are played, with their own pictures; Lights out links to the freshness example
Market Days & the end: a Day 3 bid to Day 5 delivery strip with the stake; the upgrade cards in a row; a final count showing cash first and fruit sold as the tiebreak
The tips move beside their rules; a row of page names at the top
exclusions: No rule, balance, save or online change; the rules words are kept as they are
Not published: the live game changes only on the owner's word
